Browser assets are vendored so the demo does not require CDN access:

- Bootstrap 5.3.8 CSS — MIT, https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
- Chart.js 4.5.1 UMD — MIT, https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
- Manrope variable font — SIL Open Font License, https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope
- DM Serif Display regular font — SIL Open Font License, https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/dmserifdisplay

License files are included beside the assets and fonts.
